_source: rsprox captures local 1000338 and 1000342, and 1843 (rev 227): Add to on the Varrock Museum's lowest-floor fossil displays, each state rise, the missing-part line, the completion box, Kudos and lamp. Wiki (Kudos; Antique lamp (fossil display)): 36 displays, 2 Kudos each, the lamps' experience and level.
_displays: Every display's clickable loc(s), by its number (its state varbit is fossil_vm_display_<n>_state). The big displays 27-30 are clicked on their support half (the b loc); 25 is two halves.
_names: The cache names of the displays' unfinished states (each with Add to), and the fossil set each takes.
_pieces: State n takes piece n + 1 (recorded: state 0 limbs or roots, 1 spine, 2 ribs, 3 pelvis, 4 skull, one per click). The plant order past the roots is the same numbering, not recorded.
_lamps: Wiki (Antique lamp (fossil display)): small 2,000 XP at level 20, medium 3,500 at 30, large and plant 5,000 at 35, any skill. A plant display gives the large lamp (recorded, display 34).
_messages: Recorded. The missing-part line has two spaces after the colon on every recording.

messages.missing: You're missing part of the display:  {name}.
messages.complete: Congratulations, you have completed this display!
